changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[GetAssetDisplayValue]() RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( select A.AssetTypeID, A.ID, A.Object, A.ObjectID, string_agg(coalesce(D.FormattedValue, D.value), '') as DisplayValue from Asset A inner join AssetType T on T.ID = A.AssetTypeID outer apply ( select top 100 TL.value, coalesce(case when TL.Value = 'FirstName' then R.FirstName + ' ' else R.LastName end, F.FormattedValue, RI.Code, G.Name) as FormattedValue from [utility].[OrderedSplit](replace(T.DisplayFormat, '{', '|'), '|') TF cross apply [utility].[OrderedSplit](replace(TF.[value], '}', '|'), '|') TL left join FieldType FT on FT.AssetTypeID = T.ID and FT.Name like TL.Value left join Field F on F.FieldTypeID = FT.ID and F.AssetID = A.ID left join Asset RI on TL.Value = 'Code' and A.Object = 'ReferenceItem' and RI.ID = A.ID left join [Group] G on TL.Value = 'Name' and A.Object = 'Group' and G.ID = A.ObjectID left join reporting.Global_resource R on TL.Value in ('FirstName', 'LastName') and A.Object = 'Resource' and R.ResourceID = A.ObjectID where RTRIM(TF.value) <> '' and RTRIM(TL.value) <> '' order by TF.[index], TL.[index] ) D group by A.AssetTypeID, A.ID, A.Object, A.ObjectID )
changeSet.rollback: CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[GetAssetDisplayValue]() RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( select A.AssetTypeID, A.ID, A.Object, A.ObjectID, string_agg(coalesce(D.FormattedValue, D.value), '') as DisplayValue from Asset A inner join AssetType T on T.ID = A.AssetTypeID outer apply ( select top 100 TL.value, coalesce(case when TL.Value = 'FirstName' then R.FirstName + ' ' else R.LastName end, F.FormattedValue, RI.Code, FA.TextPath, FA.Name, FU.Name, G.Name) as FormattedValue from [utility].[OrderedSplit](replace(T.DisplayFormat, '{', '|'), '|') TF cross apply [utility].[OrderedSplit](replace(TF.[value], '}', '|'), '|') TL left join FieldType FT on FT.AssetTypeID = T.ID and FT.Name like TL.Value left join Field F on F.FieldTypeID = FT.ID and F.AssetID = A.ID left join Asset RI on TL.Value = 'Code' and A.Object = 'ReferenceItem' and RI.ID = A.ID left join FusionAttribute FA on TL.Value = 'Name' and A.Object = 'FusionAttribute' and FA.ID = A.ObjectID left join Fusion FU on TL.Value = 'Name' and A.Object = 'Fusion' and FU.ID = A.ObjectID left join [Group] G on TL.Value = 'Name' and A.Object = 'Group' and G.ID = A.ObjectID left join reporting.Global_resource R on TL.Value in ('FirstName', 'LastName') and A.Object = 'Resource' and R.ResourceID = A.ObjectID where RTRIM(TF.value) <> '' and RTRIM(TL.value) <> '' order by TF.[index], TL.[index] ) D group by A.AssetTypeID, A.ID, A.Object, A.ObjectID )
